name: seedfall-arcade
description: Seedfall Arcade: a zero-dependency web arcade of single-file HTML5 Canvas games (Pulse Breach, Neon Drift) with daily seeds, leaderboards and an ArcadeSDK bridge. Cloudflare Pages + D1.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler@3 d1 migrations apply arcade --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler@3 d1 migrations apply arcade --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npx wrangler@3 pages deploy dist --project-name seedfall-arcade
